The '''house of Parnelli''' was a [[Noble/Legends|noble]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] family from [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The Parnellis donated the funds to build a [[Parnelli Museum of Art/Legends|museum]] dedicated to the display and promotion of contemporary art style.
